generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, owning your development is something you practise in every module across the School of Sport. Each study you plan and monitor, each report or session plan you judge against the criteria, each piece of feedback you turn into action, is self-regulation at work. It is also what sport, physical activity and health professions reward: the graduate who directs their own learning and improves from feedback is the one who keeps growing.
